explanation: Jains apply it with special strictness: some monks and nuns sweep the ground ahead with a soft brush and cover their mouths with cloth, to avoid harming even tiny insects.

claims.text: Ahimsa means non-violence, or not harming living beings.
Ahimsa does not mean truthfulness (satya), non-attachment (aparigraha) or self-discipline.
Jainism applies the principle of ahimsa with particular strictness.
Some Jain monks and nuns sweep the ground ahead of them with a soft brush and wear a cloth over the mouth to avoid harming small creatures.
